resources.string: Unlocks call recording in Google Phone and adds recording options. Uses Phone\'s own recorder.
Not connected to LSPosed. Enable Dialer Enhancements in LSPosed, then reopen this app.
Google Phone is in the module\'s scope.
Google Phone isn\'t in the module\'s scope. Add it in LSPosed.
No report yet. Force-stop Google Phone, then open it once.
Google Phone or the module has changed since then. Force-stop Google Phone and open it again to refresh this page.
After installing or updating the module, force-stop Google Phone so it picks up the change.
Google Phone can\'t capture call audio on this phone. It has to be installed as a system app.
This Google Phone build can\'t record calls. Install the full version.
Google Phone reported a setup problem.

Google Phone records every call by itself: incoming and outgoing, contacts and unknown numbers. When off, Google Phone\'s own rules (unknown numbers, selected numbers) apply. Takes effect from the next call.
Adds detailed lines to the LSPosed log. Never includes phone numbers or names. Takes effect at once.
Settings are saved here and passed on to Google Phone once LSPosed connects.

\"Active\" means the change is in place, not that a call was recorded. Google Phone still needs its own recording support. Tell the other party when you record, and follow the recording laws where you are.
